title: MLflow Custom View Catalog
description: Custom A2UI catalog for the model trace explorer custom view.

allOf.description: A bordered container around a SINGLE child, themed with Databricks Design System tokens (a slightly-darker-than-white surface, border, and rounded corners) so it sits natively in the MLflow UI. To display multiple elements, wrap them in a Row/Column and pass that container's id as the child.

child.description: The id of the single child component to render inside the card.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: A single Databricks Design System icon, referenced by name. Accepts the basic catalog's Material-style names (e.g. "check", "close", "download", "search", "settings", "warning", "error", "info", "person", "folder", "star") which are mapped to the closest DS icon, plus DS-native aliases (e.g. "trash", "gear", "pencil", "tag"). Unknown names degrade gracefully to a neutral default icon. Use sparingly: most components (StatCard/AssessmentBoard/etc.) already carry their own icon.

name.description: The icon to display, e.g. "check" or "warning".

size.description: Icon size in pixels. Defaults to the inherited font size.

allOf.description: A metric card displaying a value, a caption, and a tinted icon. Matches the tool-call statistics cards on the experiment overview page.

value.description: The metric value to display, e.g. "14" or "275.71ms".

icon.description: The icon to display next to the value.

tone.description: The color tone applied to the icon.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: Renders a markdown text block (optionally under a title).

title.description: Optional heading shown above the markdown.

allOf.description: Displays a SINGLE labeled value using the Details & Timeline snippet renderer, with a format toggle (text/json/markdown for strings; an interactive JSON tree for objects/arrays). Use it to show one span attribute/input/output field directly.

label.description: The key/label shown above the value, e.g. the attribute name.

value.description: JSON-encoded value to display (object/array -> JSON tree, string -> text/markdown/json).

initialFormat.description: Initial display format for string values.

hideFormatToggle.description: When true, hides the per-value format dropdown.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: A single assessment box: the category is the header, the verdict is a colored badge, and the rationale fills the body. Sentiment drives the color (green positive, red negative/error). Reusable — append one per assessment into an AssessmentBoard (or any Row/Column).

name.description: The assessment category, shown as the box header.

value.description: The verdict/value, shown as a colored badge.

rationale.description: The explanation shown in the box body.

allOf.description: A wrapping container for assessment boxes. Renders an optional title followed by a wrapping row of child component ids (typically one AssessmentCard per assessment). Add more assessments by appending more AssessmentCard children.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the boxes.

icon.description: Optional icon shown next to the title.

children.description: The card component ids to lay out in a wrapping row.

emptyMessage.description: Text shown when there are no cards.

allOf.description: An interactive thumbs up / thumbs down control. Clicking a feedback button logs a feedback assessment (boolean: thumbs up = true, thumbs down = false) for the current trace and reflects the choice via its bound value. A lightweight alternative to the full staged feedback form; use ONLY when the user asks to collect feedback, never to display judge results.

label.description: Optional prompt shown next to the thumbs, e.g. "Was this helpful?".

name.description: The assessment name to log. Defaults to "User feedback".

value.description: Selected state: true = thumbs up, false = thumbs down. Bind to a /feedback/... data-model path to reflect and seed the choice.

spanId.description: Optional span id to scope the feedback to a specific span instead of the whole trace. Bind to a $spanRef marker so it re-targets the right span per trace.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: An interactive single-choice control for human feedback. Selecting an option stages the choice host-side under "name"; it is logged as a feedback assessment (string value) only when a FeedbackSubmit button is clicked. Emit one RadioGroup per feedback dimension, each with a unique "name".

label.description: Optional prompt shown above the options, e.g. "Who did better on Accuracy?".

name.description: The assessment name this dimension logs (also the staging key). Required and unique per dimension; a FeedbackInputText sharing this name attaches as its rationale.

options.description: The selectable options, in display order.

label.description: The option text shown to the user.

value.description: The feedback value logged when this option is selected.
Selected option value. Bind to a /feedback/... data-model path to reflect and seed the choice.

spanId.description: Optional span id to scope the feedback to a specific span instead of the whole trace. Bind to a $spanRef marker so it re-targets the right span per trace.

formId.description: REQUIRED. Which form this control belongs to. The FeedbackSubmit sharing this same "formId" submits it. Every feedback form needs a "formId" — even a single-form view. Set a distinct "formId" per form when a view has more than one submit button. A rationale FeedbackInputText must share BOTH this "formId" and the same "name" to attach.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: A feedback-scoped free-text box (not a generic input). Its text is staged host-side under "name" and logged only on FeedbackSubmit. "field" controls what the text populates: "rationale" (default) attaches an optional why to a RadioGroup sharing the same "name"; "value" makes a standalone free-text feedback value (no radio needed).

label.description: Optional prompt shown above the box, e.g. "Optional rationale (why?)".

name.description: The assessment name this text logs (also the staging key). Match a RadioGroup's name to attach as that dimension's rationale; use a unique name for a standalone free-text feedback value.

field.description: Whether the typed text becomes the assessment "value" or its "rationale". Defaults to "rationale".

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the box is empty.

value.description: Bind to a /feedback/... data-model path to reflect and seed the text.

spanId.description: Optional span id to scope the feedback to a specific span instead of the whole trace. Bind to a $spanRef marker so it re-targets the right span per trace.

formId.description: REQUIRED. Which form this control belongs to. The FeedbackSubmit sharing this same "formId" submits it. As a rationale (field "rationale"), match BOTH the "formId" and "name" of the RadioGroup it annotates. Every feedback form needs a "formId" — even a single-form view. Set a distinct "formId" per form when a view has more than one submit button.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.

allOf.description: A button that submits the staged feedback (from RadioGroup / FeedbackInputText) belonging to its form. Clicking it logs one assessment per staged dimension in that form and clears those staged values.

formId.description: REQUIRED. Which form this button submits. It flushes every RadioGroup / FeedbackInputText sharing this same "formId" (across any spans), and only those. Every feedback form needs a "formId" — even a single-form view (its controls and submit share one id). Give each form a distinct "formId" when a view has more than one submit button.

weight.description: Relative flex weight when placed directly inside a Row/Column.
